scope: Read-only SERVREG_NOTIF state query for resolved domain path msm/modem/wlan_pd using the bounded local SERVREG domain-map endpoint at port 0x4003. The Service Locator alias wlan/fw resolves to this domain path. Bind the exact SERVREG_NOTIF service, send one state query, and accept only its transaction- and endpoint-matched response. Trace separate FlowBusy and NoCapacity LOC reply waits plus whether the first queued reply received a matching QRTR RESUME_TX. No listener registration, RESTART_PD, WLFW client, MSA_INFO, SCM ownership transfer, MSA_READY, WLAN MSA grant, WLAN power, DMA, firmware transfer, radio start, or retry.
